meaning: "Of Cytherea, born in Cyprus, I will sing." The opening of the short Homeric Hymn to Aphrodite, goddess of love and beauty.
purpose: To honour love, beauty and desire as sacred.
note: Friday is Venus’s day (Aphrodite is the Greek Venus); in the north it is Frigg’s or Freyja’s, in India Shukra’s. Translation: Hugh G. Evelyn-White, 1914 (public domain).
source: Homeric Hymn 10, To Aphrodite, line 1 (Perseus); translation Hugh G. Evelyn-White, 1914
name: Hymn to Aphrodite
